entities.name: Ivan Turyanytsia

entities.summary: Ivan Ivanovych Turyanytsia was a Czechoslovak, Ukrainian and Soviet politician, who served as the chairman of the People's Council of Zakarpattia Ukraine from 1944 to 1946 and the First secretary of the Communist Party of Zakarpattia Ukraine.
